title: correlation_summary: return pairwise Pearson correlations between numeric columns
description: Compute pairwise Pearson correlation between numeric columns and return a long-format table sorted by absolute correlation. Useful for exploring numeric relationships.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: List of numeric columns to include (default: all numeric columns).

rag_note: Requires at least 2 numeric columns. Returns col_a, col_b, correlation rows. Empty columns list uses all numeric columns in the dataset.
